new_promises.statement: We maintain a long-term EBITDA margin range of 19% to 21% for the coming year.
new_promises.quote: In terms of a long-term range, even for the coming year, we are maintaining a similar range of 19% to 21% as the EBITDA that we look to deliver.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra

new_promises.statement: We expect to expand JKY Groove reach to about 500 EBOs by April 2026.
new_promises.quote: It is expected to expand to about 500 EBOs.
new_promises.speaker: Karthik Yathindra

new_promises.statement: We aim to reach revenues of Rs. 8,000 crores by FY29.
new_promises.quote: The guidance on where we see our revenues by FY’29 at Rs. 8,000 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Sheela Rathi
